text: Brainvest Wealth Management is an independent wealth manager founded in Geneva in 2003, run as a partnership; its own site lists Dany Roizman as founder.
short: Brainvest is an independent, partner-run wealth manager founded in Geneva in 2003.

additionalSources.quote: Since 2003, Brainvest has built differentiated investment solutions with the highest level of governance and engagement
